features: Massive 7000mAh Battery: Go up to 3 days on a single charge, with up to 49.7 hours of calling, 26.8 hours of YouTube playback, 14.4 hours of video calling, and 8.47 hours of gaming, built to keep you powered through the day

Smooth 120Hz Display: Enjoy a fluid and immersive viewing experience on the large 6.75” display with an adaptive 60/90/120Hz refresh rate. From scrolling and streaming to gaming, the display intelligently adjusts to deliver a smooth and responsive experience.
Fast & Smooth: Enjoy 36 months of fast & smooth performance, while the battery is designed to retain its health for up to 6 years, delivering reliable performance over the long run.

AI-Powered Smart Camera: Capture clearer, more refined photos with the 13MP Ultra-Clear AI-enhanced camera. Features like AI Eraser and AI Clear Face make it easy to enhance portraits, remove unwanted objects, and create better-looking shots with minimal effort.

Reliable Everyday Performance: Powered by an efficient octa-core processor, up to 4GB RAM (boostable to 8GB virtual RAM), 64GB UFS 2.2 storage, and up to 2TB expandable space via a separately purchased microSD card, the OnePlus N6 Lite delivers smooth, dependable everyday performance.

Military-Grade Durability: Tested to MIL-STD-810H standards, OnePlus N6 Lite is built to last. It also features IP64 dust and splash resistance. Aqua Touch support ensures the screen remains responsive even with wet or oily hands and while wearing gloves, keeping you connected without interruptions.
